courseLabels.s_curve: S-curve (lane change): 5 m ahead, 1.6 m to the left, min radius 1.1 m, heading held
courseLabels.hairpin: 2 m out, 180 deg turn on a 1 m radius (0.75 m at the joins), 2 m back; heading held
courseLabels.slalom: through 3 gate centres at x = 1.75 / 3.5 / 5.25 m, y = +0.4 / -0.4 / +0.4 m
courseLabels.long_auto: auto-style route, heading 0 -> 90 deg at waypoint 2 -> 180 deg at the end
courseLabels.figure_eight: a self-crossing loop (a lemniscate, 4 m x 1.8 m) through the origin twice; heading held
courseLabels.wall_hug: along a wall with the bumpers 15 cm off it, then a 90 deg turn to run 15 cm off the next wall
courseLabels.spin_while_driving: 5 m straight while the robot turns a full 360 deg (a heading target at every waypoint)
courseLabels.fast_long: an 8 m gentle curve with a 5 m/s cap (above the robot's 4.57 m/s free speed)
courseLabels.heavy_robot: the S-curve with a 68 kg robot (MOI 6.8) and a 192 A current limit (20 % lower)
courseLabels.hit_mid_path: the S-curve with a 0.3 s lateral shove (to the left of travel) at half distance
courseLabels.low_grip_s_curve: the S-curve on mu 0.91 static / 0.79 kinetic (61 % of normal grip)

settleRule: within 2 cm and 1 deg of the end pose, true speed under 5 cm/s, held 0.25 s
